definitions.explanation: The act of applying pressure to compress, squeeze out liquid, or condense something.

examples.japanese: {圧搾|あっさく}⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: The machine runs on compressed air.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリーブ→オリーブ：10808_oriibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{圧搾|あっさく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{圧搾|あっさく}⟦{製法|せいほう}→製法：14038_seihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だ。
examples.english: This juice is made by the cold-press method, so it has a rich flavor.

notes:
Refers to applying mechanical pressure to squeeze, compress, or extract liquid from something. Common in industrial contexts (compressed air, hydraulic presses) and increasingly in food marketing, where {圧搾|あっさく} methods are promoted as producing higher-quality oils and juices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧搾|あっさく}⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: compressed air
- {圧搾|あっさく}{機|き}: pressing machine; press
- {圧搾|あっさく}⟦{製法|せいほう}→製法：14038_seihou⟧: pressing method (for oil, juice)
- コールド{圧搾|あっさく}: cold pressing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{圧縮|あっしゅく}→圧縮：04884_asshuku⟧: compression — reducing volume (gas, data), not extracting liquid
- ⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧: to squeeze/wring — the everyday verb for squeezing liquid out
